Straight answers

## Fort Mill questions

### Is every Fort Mill address inside the town limits?

No. The town says plainly that a Fort Mill address does not necessarily mean a property is inside the incorporated town. Town limits affect services and taxes, so check the parcel with York County.

### Which school district serves Fort Mill?

Fort Mill School District 4, for homes inside its lines. Look up the exact address on York County’s school locator (<https://experience.arcgis.com/experience/e827d330f20a4508aa6777bf2c0b94e3/page/Find-My-Schools/>) .

### How do South Carolina property taxes work in Fort Mill?

The big variable is the assessment ratio. A Fort Mill home you live in can be assessed at 4% of value once you apply for the legal-residence rate; without the application, or for a second home or vacant lot, it is 6%, per the SC Department of Revenue (<https://dor.sc.gov/property/property-tax-exemptions>) . York County (<https://www.yorkcountysc.gov/789/Tax-Information>) handles the application through its Assessor’s Office.

### Which roads matter most in Fort Mill?

I-77 for Charlotte and Rock Hill, SC 160 through town and US 21, the older highway the town grew up on. SCDOT is rebuilding the exit 85 interchange at SC 160.

### What are Baxter Village and Kingsley?

Two of Fort Mill’s planned communities. Baxter Village, across I-77 from downtown, has sidewalk cafés, pubs and shops built into the plan. Expect HOA covenants and fees in planned communities, and read them early.

Day to day

## York between two interstates

### Getting around

The City of York describes itself as positioned equidistant between the I-77 and I-85 corridors. SCDOT traffic counts carry SC 5, SC 49, SC 161 and US 321 through the area, and SC 49 is the road northeast toward Lake Wylie. Downtown is laid out along Congress Street, with the York County Courthouse at 2 S. Congress St.

### Schools and services

York County has four school districts. The City of York is in York School District 1 (<https://www.york.k12.sc.us/our-schools>) , which runs ten schools across western York County. Confirm the assignment for the exact address with York County’s school locator (<https://experience.arcgis.com/experience/e827d330f20a4508aa6777bf2c0b94e3/page/Find-My-Schools/>) .

### Landmarks and weekends

Downtown, Books-4-Ewe is at 15 N. Congress St. and Working Theory Beer Co. at 16 E. Liberty St. West of town, Kings Mountain State Park covers 6,883 acres with a Living History Farm, Lake York and Lake Crawford, and its Ridgeline Trail connects to Kings Mountain National Military Park and Crowders Mountain. Historic Brattonsville, at 1444 Brattonsville Rd. in McConnells, marks the Battle of Huck’s Defeat on July 12, 1780.

Yes. The county courthouse is downtown at 2 S. Congress St., which is why so much of York’s historic core sits along Congress Street.

### Which school district serves York, SC?

York School District 1 (<https://www.york.k12.sc.us/our-schools>) serves western York County, including the city. Confirm by address on the county school locator (<https://experience.arcgis.com/experience/e827d330f20a4508aa6777bf2c0b94e3/page/Find-My-Schools/>) .

### How do property taxes work for a York primary home?

Apply for the legal-residence ratio soon after closing. South Carolina assesses an owner-occupied primary home at 4% instead of 6% only when the owner applies, the SC Department of Revenue (<https://dor.sc.gov/property/property-tax-exemptions>) explains, and York County (<https://www.yorkcountysc.gov/789/Tax-Information>) adds relief on school operating millage for a legal residence.

### What state parks are near York?

Kings Mountain State Park, 6,883 acres with two lakes and a Living History Farm, and its Ridgeline Trail link to the national military park and Crowders Mountain in North Carolina.

### Can I renovate a historic home in York?

Usually, but exterior changes in the historic district can require design review. Ask the City of York planning office before you budget a renovation.

## Getting around Rock Hill

### Getting around

The city lists five I-77 exits: 82 for Cherry Road (US 21) and Celanese Road (SC 161), 79 for Dave Lyle Boulevard (SC 122), 77 for US 21 and SC 5, 75 for Porter Road and 73 for SC 901. From exit 79, Dave Lyle Boulevard reaches Main Street downtown in about 3.7 miles. Cherry Road, Celanese Road, Anderson Road and Heckle Boulevard are the other main corridors.

### Schools and services

Most of the city is served by Rock Hill Schools (<https://www.rock-hill.k12.sc.us/>) , York County School District 3. York County has four districts, drawn separately from city limits, so look up the exact address on York County’s school locator (<https://experience.arcgis.com/experience/e827d330f20a4508aa6777bf2c0b94e3/page/Find-My-Schools/>) .

### Landmarks and weekends

Cherry Park, at 1466 Cherry Rd., opened in 1985 and is still the center of the city’s parks system. Old Town has the Mural Mile and Fountain Park, where ChristmasVille opens in December, and Glencairn Garden is the classic spring walk. Catawba Bend Preserve protects 1,900 acres on the river.

### How big is Rock Hill?

The city describes itself as York County’s largest city, with more than 75,000 residents, about 20 miles south of Charlotte on I-77.

### Which I-77 exit is best for downtown Rock Hill?

Exit 79. Dave Lyle Boulevard (SC 122) runs about 3.7 miles west to Main Street.

### How do South Carolina property taxes work in Rock Hill?

Rock Hill buyers moving from North Carolina are often surprised that the rate depends on an application. A primary residence qualifies for the 4% assessment ratio, while rentals, second homes and land are taxed at 6% (SC Department of Revenue (<https://dor.sc.gov/property/property-tax-exemptions>) ). File with the York County Assessor (<https://www.yorkcountysc.gov/789/Tax-Information>) ; city taxes apply inside Rock Hill limits.

Old Town’s Mural Mile and the York County Visitors Center at 130 E. Main St., then Glencairn Garden.

## Lincolnton’s roads, schools and river

### Getting around

US 321 is the limited-access highway between Gastonia, Lincolnton and Hickory, according to the city’s land use plan. NCDOT’s transportation plan for Lincolnton calls NC 27 the county’s only major east-west corridor to the Charlotte area, and NC 150 links downtown with the Lake Norman side of Lincoln County. From Dallas or Gastonia, US 321 is the road you will use most.

### Schools and services

Lincolnton is served by Lincoln County Schools (<https://www.lcsnc.org/>) , a separate district from Gaston County Schools, with its central office at 201 Jeb Seagle Drive. The district groups its schools into zones, so confirm the assignment for the exact address with the district before you write an offer. Gaston College (<https://www.gaston.edu/locations-maps-directions/>) also has a Lincoln Campus in Lincolnton.

### Landmarks and weekends

Lincolnton is home to Catawba Valley pottery, and the city’s Pots on Parade line East Main Street. The Marcia Cloninger Rail Trail, part of the Carolina Thread Trail, runs 1.7 miles from City Park to First Federal Park downtown, past the Motz Street Dog Park and Betty G. Ross Park, and the South Fork River has a blueway launch and fishing pier. The calendar includes the Battle of Ramsour’s Mill weekend in June, the Apple Festival in October and Alive After Five downtown.

Straight answers

## Lincolnton questions

### Is Lincolnton in Gaston County?

No. Lincolnton is the seat of Lincoln County, just north of Gaston County. Incorporated in 1785, it is the second-oldest town west of the Catawba River and the only incorporated city in a mostly rural county.

### What are property taxes like in Lincoln County?

The NC Department of Revenue (<https://www.ncdor.gov/taxes-forms/property-tax/property-tax-rates/county-property-tax-rates-and-reappraisal-schedules>) lists Lincoln County at 49.9 cents per $100 of assessed value for 2026–27, with a 2023 reappraisal. Gaston County is 59.9 cents. Homes inside city limits also pay a city rate, so compare combined figures.

### Which school district serves Lincolnton?

Lincoln County Schools (<https://www.lcsnc.org/>) . Confirm the specific school for the address with the district.

### How do you get from Lincolnton to Gastonia?

US 321, a limited-access highway that runs south past Gaston College in Dallas to I-85 at Gastonia.

### What is downtown Lincolnton like?

A courthouse town. The 1921 Lincoln County Courthouse is on the National Register, the Lincoln Cultural Center is at 403 E. Main St., and the city publishes a historic downtown walking tour.

Living in Concord

## What to know about Concord

01

## Where is Concord, and how does it relate to Charlotte?

Concord is the largest city in Cabarrus County and its county seat, northeast of Charlotte along I-85. Most people who move here think of it as its own city rather than a suburb, with a courthouse downtown, its own airport and a long list of employers. From Gaston County, the drive runs the full width of Charlotte, so buyers comparing Concord with Belmont or Gastonia are really choosing which side of the metro to build a life around.

02

## What is downtown Concord like?

Concord was founded in 1796 after a dispute over where the new county seat should go, and the town took a name meaning harmony. Union Street became the main road and still is. The 1876 Historic Cabarrus County Courthouse anchors downtown and holds the Davis Theatre and gallery space, with locally owned restaurants and shops along the surrounding blocks.

03

## Which Concord neighborhoods have historic homes?

The City of Concord protects three historic districts. The North and South Union Street Historic Districts were established in 1982 and are listed on the National Register of Historic Places. Edgewood was designated as a local historic district in 1988. Exterior changes in these districts go before the Historic Preservation Commission, which matters if you plan to renovate.

04

## What is western Concord known for?

The west side is where Concord gets its racing reputation. Charlotte Motor Speedway, zMAX Dragway and Concord Mills sit here, along with Concord-Padgett Regional Airport, which the city owns. That part of town is busier and more commercial, and newer subdivisions spread out from the I-85 corridor. Event schedules at the speedway affect traffic, so check the calendar before you tour on a race weekend.

05

## How do Cabarrus County property taxes compare with Gaston County?

The North Carolina Department of Revenue lists the Cabarrus County rate at 57.6 cents per $100 of assessed value for 2025–26, after a 2024 reappraisal. Gaston County’s rate is 59.9 cents as of July 1, 2026. City taxes are added on top for homes inside Concord city limits, so ask for the full combined rate on any address you are serious about.

06

## Concord or Gaston County: how should you decide?

Start with where you will drive most. If work, family or school sits northeast of Charlotte, Concord saves real time. If your week points toward the airport, the west side of Charlotte or York County in South Carolina, Gaston County towns like Belmont, Mount Holly and Gastonia usually fit better. Ally can help you set the two side by side.

07

## How does Ally help Concord buyers?

Ally’s home base is Belmont, and most of her recorded sales are in Gaston, Cleveland and York counties. She is honest about that. For Concord, she can help you think through the move, compare it with west-side towns she knows street by street, and point you to the right resources before you commit.

Ask whether a home is inside Concord city limits and which county services apply, because city taxes, trash and utilities change with the boundary. Race-weekend traffic near the speedway is part of life on the west side.

Living in Mooresville

## What to know about Mooresville

01

## Why is Mooresville called Race City USA?

The town says it plainly: Mooresville is home to many NASCAR teams and drivers, an IndyCar team and racing technology suppliers. It is also home to the corporate headquarters of Lowe’s and Universal Technical Institute’s NASCAR Technical Institute. Those employers shape the commute patterns and explain why so many households here have ties to racing or retail.

02

## How big is Lake Norman?

Lake Norman was created when Duke Energy’s predecessor built Cowans Ford Dam on the Catawba River, starting in 1959. North Carolina’s Department of Natural and Cultural Resources describes it as more than 32,000 acres, the largest manmade body of water in the state, touching Catawba, Iredell, Lincoln and Mecklenburg counties. Mooresville sits on its northeastern shore.

03

## Which schools serve a Mooresville address?

This is the question that trips up the most buyers. Mooresville has its own public school system, the Mooresville Graded School District, alongside Iredell-Statesville Schools. A Mooresville mailing address does not guarantee either one. Both districts publish zoning maps, and you should confirm the assignment for the exact property before you make an offer.

04

## What is downtown Mooresville like?

Downtown is compact and walkable, with the Mooresville Museum, Mooresville Arts in the old train depot and D.E. Turner Hardware, which has been on Main Street since 1899.

05

## How do Iredell County taxes compare with Gaston County?

The North Carolina Department of Revenue lists Iredell County at 50 cents per $100 of assessed value for 2025–26. Gaston County is 59.9 cents as of July 1, 2026. Homes inside Mooresville town limits also pay a town rate, and lakefront values push total bills higher, so compare the full estimate rather than the county rate alone.

06

## Lake Norman or Lake Wylie?

Both lakes sit on the Catawba River chain. Lake Norman is larger and farther north. Lake Wylie is closer to Belmont, Gastonia and York County, South Carolina, and it is where Ally works most often. If your work or family points west or south of Charlotte, tour Lake Wylie before you decide. Lincoln County’s side of Lake Norman is another option closer to Gaston County.

07

## How does Ally help Mooresville buyers?

Ally is based in Belmont, and her recorded sales are concentrated in Gaston, Cleveland and York counties rather than Iredell. She can help you compare lake markets, think through docks, flood zones and insurance with a builder’s eye, and decide whether Mooresville or a lake town closer to Gaston County fits your week better.

Before you buy in Mooresville

Confirm the school district for the exact address, plus dock permits, flood-zone status and insurance on any waterfront home. Lakefront rules vary by cove, so check them before you compare prices.

## Getting around Mooresville

### Getting around

I-77 runs west of downtown Mooresville, with exit 33 at US 21/Williamson Road and exit 36 at NC 150. The town describes NC 115 and Langtree Road as key corridors linking downtown with I-77 and with Davidson, Cornelius, Huntersville and Charlotte to the south. NC 150 is being widened, and Iredell County’s ICATS Iredell Express uses the I-77 express toll lanes to reach Uptown Charlotte, with a stop at exit 36.

Straight answers

## Mooresville questions

### Which I-77 exits serve Mooresville?

Exit 36 at NC 150 and exit 33 at US 21/Williamson Road are the main ones. NC 115 and Langtree Road connect downtown with the interstate.

### Is there a commuter bus from Mooresville to Charlotte?

Yes. Iredell County’s ICATS Iredell Express runs weekday peak trips on the I-77 express lanes to Uptown Charlotte, stopping at exit 36. Check the current schedule with ICATS.

### Which school system serves my Mooresville address?

Either the Mooresville Graded School District (<https://www.mgsd.k12.nc.us/65100_2>) or Iredell-Statesville Schools. The mailing address does not decide it, so check both districts’ zoning maps.

### What are Iredell County property taxes?

The NC Department of Revenue (<https://www.ncdor.gov/taxes-forms/property-tax/property-tax-rates/county-property-tax-rates-and-reappraisal-schedules>) lists Iredell County at 50 cents per $100 of assessed value for 2026–27. Town taxes apply on top inside Mooresville limits.

### Why is Mooresville called Race City USA?

The town is home to many NASCAR teams and drivers, an IndyCar team and racing suppliers, along with Lowe’s corporate headquarters.

Living in Wesley Chapel

## What to know about Wesley Chapel

01

## What kind of place is Wesley Chapel?

Wesley Chapel is a village, not a city, and it was created to stay that way. The General Assembly ratified its charter on July 15, 1998, with a mayor and a four-member village council. Its land use plan, published through Union County, sets the goal of keeping the strong single-family, low-density residential character of the village and limiting commercial development to a few planned locations.

02

## Where is Wesley Chapel?

The village sits in western Union County, southeast of Charlotte, with village hall on Weddington Road. Its neighbors include Weddington, Waxhaw, Indian Trail and Monroe, the Union County seat. Many addresses that say Wesley Chapel, Monroe or Waxhaw on the envelope sit close to one another, so confirm whether a home is inside the village limits before you rely on village rules.

03

## What are homes like in Wesley Chapel?

Expect mostly single-family neighborhoods and larger lots than you will find closer to Charlotte, with commercial activity grouped near the main crossroads rather than spread along every road. That suits buyers who want quiet streets and room around the house. It also means more driving for groceries, school pickup and dinner out.

04

## How do Union County property taxes compare?

The North Carolina Department of Revenue lists Union County at 43.42 cents per $100 of assessed value for 2025–26, after a 2025 reappraisal. Gaston County is 59.9 cents as of July 1, 2026. The village levies its own rate on top of the county rate, so ask for the combined figure and the current assessed value on any home you are considering.

05

## Which schools serve Wesley Chapel?

Public schools here are run by Union County Public Schools, a separate system from Gaston County Schools or the York County districts in South Carolina. Attendance lines can change as the county grows, so check the district’s school locator for the specific address instead of trusting a listing description.

06

## Wesley Chapel or Gaston County?

The two sit on opposite sides of Charlotte. If your job or family is in south or east Charlotte, Matthews or Monroe, Wesley Chapel can make sense. If you are pointed toward the airport, west Charlotte or the South Carolina line near Lake Wylie, towns like Belmont, Mount Holly and Gastonia shorten the week.

07

## How does Ally help Wesley Chapel buyers?

Ally is based in Belmont and her recorded sales center on Gaston, Cleveland and York counties, not Union County. She will tell you that up front. What she can offer is a frank comparison with the west-side towns she knows well and a builder’s view of lot size, drainage and construction quality on any home you are weighing.

Before you buy in Wesley Chapel

Union County has its own school system and tax rates. Confirm whether a home is inside village limits, because a Wesley Chapel, Monroe or Waxhaw mailing address does not settle which rules apply.

## Wesley Chapel roads and schools

### Getting around

Village hall is at 6490 Weddington Road. The village land use plan, published through Union County, tracks traffic on NC 84 and lists congestion among residents’ concerns. Neighbors include Weddington, Waxhaw, Indian Trail and Monroe, the county seat.

### Schools and services

Union County Public Schools (<https://www.ucps.k12.nc.us/Page/2076>) runs the public schools. Wesley Chapel Elementary is at 110 Potter Road South, and the district’s directory lists Sun Valley Middle on Wesley Chapel Road in Indian Trail. Attendance lines change as the county grows, so confirm by address.

Straight answers

## Wesley Chapel questions

### Is Wesley Chapel a town or a village?

A village. Its charter was ratified on July 15, 1998, with a mayor and a four-member village council, and its land use plan aims to keep a low-density residential character.

### Which roads run through Wesley Chapel?

NC 84 is the state road the village plan tracks most closely, and village hall sits on Weddington Road. The plan keeps commercial activity to a few planned locations.

### Which schools serve Wesley Chapel?

Union County Public Schools. Check the district directory (<https://www.ucps.k12.nc.us/Page/2076>) and confirm the assignment for the address.

### What are Union County property taxes?

The NC Department of Revenue (<https://www.ncdor.gov/taxes-forms/property-tax/property-tax-rates/county-property-tax-rates-and-reappraisal-schedules>) lists Union County at 43.42 cents per $100 of assessed value for 2026–27, after a 2025 reappraisal. The village rate is added on top.

### Does a Wesley Chapel mailing address mean I am in the village?

Not always. Monroe, Waxhaw and Wesley Chapel addresses overlap, so confirm the parcel is inside village limits.

Straight answers

## Questions about Ally’s listings

### How do I schedule a showing?

Open the home’s page and use “Schedule a tour” to share a few times that work, or call Ally at (704) 486-2900. She confirms a private appointment and can send anything you want to review first. If you decide to make an offer, North Carolina requires a written agency agreement with your agent before they make an offer for you, as the NCREC’s NCREC: Working With Real Estate Agents (<https://www.ncrec.gov/Brochures/WWREABrochure.pdf>) brochure explains. See how Ally represents buyers (<https://allybohananrealestate.com/ally-bohanan-real-estate-preview/buyer-agent-services-in-gastonia-nc/>) .

### What happens after my offer is accepted?

In North Carolina, the standard Offer to Purchase gives the buyer a due diligence period, negotiated with the seller, for inspections, a survey, the appraisal, the loan and repair talks. The buyer may pay the seller a negotiated due diligence fee for that right. The NCREC’s NCREC: “Due Diligence” Questions and Answers (<https://bulletins.ncrec.gov/due-diligence-questions-and-answers/>) explains how it works. South Carolina contracts work differently, so Ally walks you through the terms on each side of the state line. A closing attorney handles the closing in both states.

### What disclosures will I see on these homes?

In North Carolina, the seller of a home generally must give the buyer the Residential Property and Owners’ Association Disclosure Statement before an offer (NCREC: the revised Residential Property and Owners’ Association Disclosure Statement (<https://bulletins.ncrec.gov/rolling-out-the-revised-rpoads/>) ). In South Carolina, the owner provides the SC Real Estate Commission: Residential Property Condition Disclosure Statement (<https://www.llr.sc.gov/re/recpdf/Property-Condition-Disclosure-Statement-06.2025.pdf>) before a contract is signed. Some sales are exempt, such as certain new construction. Ally can tell you which forms apply to the home you like.

### Can I see what Ally’s homes sold for?

Yes. Homes Ally has sold (<https://allybohananrealestate.com/ally-bohanan-real-estate-preview/sold-homes/>) lists every sale on her Zillow profile with the price, the date and whether she represented the buyer or the seller, and each home has its own page. If you are thinking about selling, start with a pricing consultation (<https://allybohananrealestate.com/ally-bohanan-real-estate-preview/home-value-in-gastonia-nc/>) .

Tell Ally the town, the size and the timing with the form below, and she will watch for new listings that fit. You can also compare towns with Find My Carolina Community (<https://allybohananrealestate.com/ally-bohanan-real-estate-preview/communities/find-my-fit/>) or weigh building with Should I Buy or Build? ## Before you buy land here

A lot can look ready to build and still carry surprises. These checks come before any offer or building plan. Ally’s guide to buying land and building (<https://allybohananrealestate.com/ally-bohanan-real-estate-preview/step-by-step-guide-to-buying-land-and-building-a-custom-home-in-gastonia-nc-2026/>) and Should I Buy or Build? (<https://allybohananrealestate.com/ally-bohanan-real-estate-preview/should-i-buy-or-build/>) walk through the rest, and Bohanan Construction (<https://allybohananrealestate.com/ally-bohanan-real-estate-preview/bohanan-construction/>) can talk through a build.

- Pull the parcel recordStart with York County GIS and One Map parcel reports (<https://www.yorkcountysc.gov/234/GIS>) : parcel lines, acreage and ownership. A licensed surveyor confirms the boundaries on the ground.
- Confirm zoning and what you can buildAsk York County Zoning (<https://www.yorkcountysc.gov/377/Zoning>) what the zoning allows and whether a town’s rules apply instead. Check recorded restrictions or covenants, too.
- Plan water and septic earlyWithout public sewer, a home needs a septic permit, and a private well needs its own permit. See SC Department of Environmental Services: residential septic permits (<https://des.sc.gov/permits-regulations/septic-tanks/permits-licenses/septic-tanks-residential-single-home-builder>) .
- Check flood zones, access and utilitiesConfirm road access, power and any floodplain on the lot before you plan a house site.

Links checked November 19, 2026: York County GIS and One Map parcel reports (<https://www.yorkcountysc.gov/234/GIS>) · York County Zoning (<https://www.yorkcountysc.gov/377/Zoning>) · SC Department of Environmental Services: residential septic permits (<https://des.sc.gov/permits-regulations/septic-tanks/permits-licenses/septic-tanks-residential-single-home-builder>) . Rules, boundaries and assignments change, so confirm with each office.

## Before you buy land here

A lot can look ready to build and still carry surprises. These checks come before any offer or building plan. Ally’s guide to buying land and building (<https://allybohananrealestate.com/ally-bohanan-real-estate-preview/step-by-step-guide-to-buying-land-and-building-a-custom-home-in-gastonia-nc-2026/>) and Should I Buy or Build? (<https://allybohananrealestate.com/ally-bohanan-real-estate-preview/should-i-buy-or-build/>) walk through the rest, and Bohanan Construction (<https://allybohananrealestate.com/ally-bohanan-real-estate-preview/bohanan-construction/>) can talk through a build.

- Pull the parcel recordStart with Gaston County GIS property search (<https://gis.gastoncountync.gov/Search/Index>) : parcel lines, acreage and ownership. A licensed surveyor confirms the boundaries on the ground.
- Confirm zoning and what you can buildAsk Gaston County Planning and Zoning (<https://gastongov.com/185/Planning-and-Zoning>) what the zoning allows and whether a town’s rules apply instead. Check recorded restrictions or covenants, too.
- Plan water and septic earlyWithout public sewer, a home needs a septic permit, and a private well needs its own permit. See Gaston County Environmental Health: on-site wastewater and wells (<https://gastongov.com/1220/On-Site-Wastewater-and-Wells>) .
- Check flood zones, access and utilitiesConfirm road access, power and any floodplain on the lot before you plan a house site. For Gaston County, see the flood zone checklist (<https://allybohananrealestate.com/ally-bohanan-real-estate-preview/flood-zones-in-gaston-county-nc-what-buyers-must-check-2026/>) .

Links checked November 19, 2026: Gaston County GIS property search (<https://gis.gastoncountync.gov/Search/Index>) · Gaston County Planning and Zoning (<https://gastongov.com/185/Planning-and-Zoning>) · Gaston County Environmental Health: on-site wastewater and wells (<https://gastongov.com/1220/On-Site-Wastewater-and-Wells>) . Rules, boundaries and assignments change, so confirm with each office.

## Before you buy land here

A lot can look ready to build and still carry surprises. These checks come before any offer or building plan. Ally’s guide to buying land and building (<https://allybohananrealestate.com/ally-bohanan-real-estate-preview/step-by-step-guide-to-buying-land-and-building-a-custom-home-in-gastonia-nc-2026/>) and Should I Buy or Build? (<https://allybohananrealestate.com/ally-bohanan-real-estate-preview/should-i-buy-or-build/>) walk through the rest, and Bohanan Construction (<https://allybohananrealestate.com/ally-bohanan-real-estate-preview/bohanan-construction/>) can talk through a build.

- Pull the parcel recordStart with Cherokee County GIS parcel map (<https://cherokeecountysc.gov/gis-mapping/gis-parcel-map/>) : parcel lines, acreage and ownership. A licensed surveyor confirms the boundaries on the ground.
- Confirm zoning and what you can buildAsk Cherokee County Zoning (<https://cherokeecountysc.gov/capital-and-planning-projects/zoning/>) what the zoning allows and whether a town’s rules apply instead. Check recorded restrictions or covenants, too.
- Plan water and septic earlyWithout public sewer, a home needs a septic permit, and a private well needs its own permit. See SC Department of Environmental Services: residential septic permits (<https://des.sc.gov/permits-regulations/septic-tanks/permits-licenses/septic-tanks-residential-single-home-builder>) .
- Check flood zones, access and utilitiesConfirm road access, power and any floodplain on the lot before you plan a house site.

Links checked November 19, 2026: Cherokee County GIS parcel map (<https://cherokeecountysc.gov/gis-mapping/gis-parcel-map/>) · Cherokee County Zoning (<https://cherokeecountysc.gov/capital-and-planning-projects/zoning/>) · SC Department of Environmental Services: residential septic permits (<https://des.sc.gov/permits-regulations/septic-tanks/permits-licenses/septic-tanks-residential-single-home-builder>) . Rules, boundaries and assignments change, so confirm with each office.

## Before you buy land here

A lot can look ready to build and still carry surprises. These checks come before any offer or building plan. Ally’s guide to buying land and building (<https://allybohananrealestate.com/ally-bohanan-real-estate-preview/step-by-step-guide-to-buying-land-and-building-a-custom-home-in-gastonia-nc-2026/>) and Should I Buy or Build? (<https://allybohananrealestate.com/ally-bohanan-real-estate-preview/should-i-buy-or-build/>) walk through the rest, and Bohanan Construction (<https://allybohananrealestate.com/ally-bohanan-real-estate-preview/bohanan-construction/>) can talk through a build.

- Pull the parcel recordStart with Cleveland County GIS services (<https://www.clevelandcounty.com/main/departments/planning___zoning/gis_services.php>) : parcel lines, acreage and ownership. A licensed surveyor confirms the boundaries on the ground.
- Confirm zoning and what you can buildAsk Cleveland County Planning & Zoning (<https://www.clevelandcounty.com/main/departments/planning___zoning/>) what the zoning allows and whether a town’s rules apply instead. Check recorded restrictions or covenants, too.
- Plan water and septic earlyWithout public sewer, a home needs a septic permit, and a private well needs its own permit. See Cleveland County Planning & Zoning FAQs (septic records are kept by Environmental Health) (<https://www.clevelandcounty.com/main/departments/planning___zoning/planning___zoning_faqs.php>) .
- Check flood zones, access and utilitiesConfirm road access, power and any floodplain on the lot before you plan a house site.

Links checked November 19, 2026: Cleveland County GIS services (<https://www.clevelandcounty.com/main/departments/planning___zoning/gis_services.php>) · Cleveland County Planning & Zoning (<https://www.clevelandcounty.com/main/departments/planning___zoning/>) · Cleveland County Planning & Zoning FAQs (septic records are kept by Environmental Health) (<https://www.clevelandcounty.com/main/departments/planning___zoning/planning___zoning_faqs.php>) . ## Before you buy land here

A lot can look ready to build and still carry surprises. These checks come before any offer or building plan. Ally’s guide to buying land and building (<https://allybohananrealestate.com/ally-bohanan-real-estate-preview/step-by-step-guide-to-buying-land-and-building-a-custom-home-in-gastonia-nc-2026/>) and Should I Buy or Build? (<https://allybohananrealestate.com/ally-bohanan-real-estate-preview/should-i-buy-or-build/>) walk through the rest, and Bohanan Construction (<https://allybohananrealestate.com/ally-bohanan-real-estate-preview/bohanan-construction/>) can talk through a build.

- Pull the parcel recordStart with Gaston County GIS property search (<https://gis.gastoncountync.gov/Search/Index>) : parcel lines, acreage and ownership. A licensed surveyor confirms the boundaries on the ground.
- Confirm zoning and what you can buildAsk Gaston County Planning and Zoning (<https://gastongov.com/185/Planning-and-Zoning>) what the zoning allows and whether a town’s rules apply instead. Check recorded restrictions or covenants, too.
- Plan water and septic earlyWithout public sewer, a home needs a septic permit, and a private well needs its own permit. See Gaston County Environmental Health: on-site wastewater and wells (<https://gastongov.com/1220/On-Site-Wastewater-and-Wells>) .
- Check flood zones, access and utilitiesConfirm road access, power and any floodplain on the lot before you plan a house site. For Gaston County, see the flood zone checklist (<https://allybohananrealestate.com/ally-bohanan-real-estate-preview/flood-zones-in-gaston-county-nc-what-buyers-must-check-2026/>) .

Links checked November 19, 2026: Gaston County GIS property search (<https://gis.gastoncountync.gov/Search/Index>) · Gaston County Planning and Zoning (<https://gastongov.com/185/Planning-and-Zoning>) · Gaston County Environmental Health: on-site wastewater and wells (<https://gastongov.com/1220/On-Site-Wastewater-and-Wells>) . Rules, boundaries and assignments change, so confirm with each office.

## Before you buy land here

A lot can look ready to build and still carry surprises. These checks come before any offer or building plan. Ally’s guide to buying land and building (<https://allybohananrealestate.com/ally-bohanan-real-estate-preview/step-by-step-guide-to-buying-land-and-building-a-custom-home-in-gastonia-nc-2026/>) and Should I Buy or Build? (<https://allybohananrealestate.com/ally-bohanan-real-estate-preview/should-i-buy-or-build/>) walk through the rest, and Bohanan Construction (<https://allybohananrealestate.com/ally-bohanan-real-estate-preview/bohanan-construction/>) can talk through a build.

- Pull the parcel recordStart with Gaston County GIS property search (<https://gis.gastoncountync.gov/Search/Index>) : parcel lines, acreage and ownership. A licensed surveyor confirms the boundaries on the ground.
- Confirm zoning and what you can buildAsk Gaston County Planning and Zoning (<https://gastongov.com/185/Planning-and-Zoning>) what the zoning allows and whether a town’s rules apply instead. Check recorded restrictions or covenants, too.
- Plan water and septic earlyWithout public sewer, a home needs a septic permit, and a private well needs its own permit. See Gaston County Environmental Health: on-site wastewater and wells (<https://gastongov.com/1220/On-Site-Wastewater-and-Wells>) .
- Check flood zones, access and utilitiesConfirm road access, power and any floodplain on the lot before you plan a house site. For Gaston County, see the flood zone checklist (<https://allybohananrealestate.com/ally-bohanan-real-estate-preview/flood-zones-in-gaston-county-nc-what-buyers-must-check-2026/>) .

Links checked November 19, 2026: Gaston County GIS property search (<https://gis.gastoncountync.gov/Search/Index>) · Gaston County Planning and Zoning (<https://gastongov.com/185/Planning-and-Zoning>) · Gaston County Environmental Health: on-site wastewater and wells (<https://gastongov.com/1220/On-Site-Wastewater-and-Wells>) . Rules, boundaries and assignments change, so confirm with each office.

## Before you buy land here

A lot can look ready to build and still carry surprises. These checks come before any offer or building plan. Ally’s guide to buying land and building (<https://allybohananrealestate.com/ally-bohanan-real-estate-preview/step-by-step-guide-to-buying-land-and-building-a-custom-home-in-gastonia-nc-2026/>) and Should I Buy or Build? (<https://allybohananrealestate.com/ally-bohanan-real-estate-preview/should-i-buy-or-build/>) walk through the rest, and Bohanan Construction (<https://allybohananrealestate.com/ally-bohanan-real-estate-preview/bohanan-construction/>) can talk through a build.

- Pull the parcel recordStart with Gaston County GIS property search (<https://gis.gastoncountync.gov/Search/Index>) : parcel lines, acreage and ownership. A licensed surveyor confirms the boundaries on the ground.
- Confirm zoning and what you can buildAsk Gaston County Planning and Zoning (<https://gastongov.com/185/Planning-and-Zoning>) what the zoning allows and whether a town’s rules apply instead. Check recorded restrictions or covenants, too.
- Plan water and septic earlyWithout public sewer, a home needs a septic permit, and a private well needs its own permit. See Gaston County Environmental Health: on-site wastewater and wells (<https://gastongov.com/1220/On-Site-Wastewater-and-Wells>) .
- Check flood zones, access and utilitiesConfirm road access, power and any floodplain on the lot before you plan a house site. For Gaston County, see the flood zone checklist (<https://allybohananrealestate.com/ally-bohanan-real-estate-preview/flood-zones-in-gaston-county-nc-what-buyers-must-check-2026/>) .

Links checked November 19, 2026: Gaston County GIS property search (<https://gis.gastoncountync.gov/Search/Index>) · Gaston County Planning and Zoning (<https://gastongov.com/185/Planning-and-Zoning>) · Gaston County Environmental Health: on-site wastewater and wells (<https://gastongov.com/1220/On-Site-Wastewater-and-Wells>) . Rules, boundaries and assignments change, so confirm with each office.

## Before you buy land here

A lot can look ready to build and still carry surprises. These checks come before any offer or building plan. Ally’s guide to buying land and building (<https://allybohananrealestate.com/ally-bohanan-real-estate-preview/step-by-step-guide-to-buying-land-and-building-a-custom-home-in-gastonia-nc-2026/>) and Should I Buy or Build? (<https://allybohananrealestate.com/ally-bohanan-real-estate-preview/should-i-buy-or-build/>) walk through the rest, and Bohanan Construction (<https://allybohananrealestate.com/ally-bohanan-real-estate-preview/bohanan-construction/>) can talk through a build.

- Pull the parcel recordStart with Gaston County GIS property search (<https://gis.gastoncountync.gov/Search/Index>) : parcel lines, acreage and ownership. A licensed surveyor confirms the boundaries on the ground.
- Confirm zoning and what you can buildAsk Gaston County Planning and Zoning (<https://gastongov.com/185/Planning-and-Zoning>) what the zoning allows and whether a town’s rules apply instead. Check recorded restrictions or covenants, too.
- Plan water and septic earlyWithout public sewer, a home needs a septic permit, and a private well needs its own permit. See Gaston County Environmental Health: on-site wastewater and wells (<https://gastongov.com/1220/On-Site-Wastewater-and-Wells>) .
- Check flood zones, access and utilitiesConfirm road access, power and any floodplain on the lot before you plan a house site. For Gaston County, see the flood zone checklist (<https://allybohananrealestate.com/ally-bohanan-real-estate-preview/flood-zones-in-gaston-county-nc-what-buyers-must-check-2026/>) .

Meet Ally

## A Realtor who knows how houses are built

Ally Bohanan is a North Carolina and South Carolina real estate broker working from an office on Main Street in Belmont. She is also the business manager and designer at Bohanan Construction, the custom-home company she runs with Chantzler Bohanan.

When you walk a house with Ally, she notices the details. Is that wall original? What would moving that kitchen involve? What should the inspection look at? Clients say it is the difference they feel most.

## Who is Pres Guy?

Pres is a mortgage lender known for clear communication, transparency and creative loan structuring across loan types. He takes a personal approach with every client, so they understand their options and feel confident throughout the process, whether they are using a conventional, FHA, VA or other program.

He believes the mortgage experience should feel supportive and educational. In his words, he chose the work because it lets him “handhold people in a caring way during the biggest financial transaction of their lives.” Outside of work, Pres is a husband to his wife Karis and dad to his daughter Spencer and son West, and you will usually find him with them, watching sports.

Start here

## Why talk with a lender before you tour homes?

A pre-approval tells you what you can comfortably spend, not just what a bank will lend. It also makes your offer stronger, because sellers want to know the financing is real. In North Carolina, your due diligence period is the window to finalize the loan, so starting early gives you time to compare programs and lock a rate.

Pres describes his favorite part of the job as helping buyers “put the puzzle pieces together so they can structure their mortgage in the most advantageous way for them and their families — both in the short term and the long term.”

The loan, step by step

## What does the mortgage process look like?

### Conversation and pre-approval

Share your goals, income and savings. The lender reviews credit and documents and issues a pre-approval.

### Shop with a number

Use the mortgage calculator (<https://allybohananrealestate.com/ally-bohanan-real-estate-preview/mortgage-calculator/>) to test payments, then tour with your buyer’s agent (<https://allybohananrealestate.com/ally-bohanan-real-estate-preview/buyer-agent-services-in-gastonia-nc/>) .

### Apply and compare

Once you are under contract, you apply. Each lender must give you a Loan Estimate, which makes comparing offers easier.

### Appraisal and underwriting

The lender orders the appraisal and verifies everything during your due diligence period.

### Clear to close

You receive your Closing Disclosure before signing, then close with your attorney.

Before you apply

## How do you check a loan officer before you apply?

Every mortgage loan officer and company must be licensed, and you can confirm both for free on NMLS Consumer Access (<https://www.nmlsconsumeraccess.org/>) , the federal-state registry that shows whether a company or individual is authorized to do business in your state. Search Pres Guy by NMLS 2156674 and American Security Mortgage Corporation by NMLS 40561.

Then compare. Ask two or three lenders for a Loan Estimate on the same day and the same loan type, and line up the interest rate, the points and the origination charges in Section A of page 2. A lender that checks your credit and declines to issue a letter must give you an adverse action notice, which tells you what to work on.

Buying across the state line? The same registry covers South Carolina, so a lender licensed in both states can help with a move between Gaston County and Fort Mill (<https://allybohananrealestate.com/ally-bohanan-real-estate-preview/fort-mill/>) , Rock Hill (<https://allybohananrealestate.com/ally-bohanan-real-estate-preview/rock-hill/>) or Clover (<https://allybohananrealestate.com/ally-bohanan-real-estate-preview/clover/>) .

Straight answers

## Mortgage questions

### Do I have to use Ally’s preferred lender?

No. You are always free to choose any lender. Many buyers compare offers from more than one, using the Loan Estimate each lender must provide after you apply.

### What is the difference between pre-qualification and pre-approval?

Less than the names suggest. The Consumer Financial Protection Bureau notes that lenders use the two terms differently: both are letters saying a lender is generally willing to lend up to an amount, based on certain assumptions, and neither is a guaranteed loan offer. Some lenders issue a prequalification on information you report and a preapproval only after verifying it. Ask the lender what they checked, and get the letter before you start touring. Read the CFPB explanation (<https://www.consumerfinance.gov/ask-cfpb/whats-the-difference-between-a-prequalification-letter-and-a-preapproval-letter-en-127/>) .

### Do I need 20 percent down and perfect credit?

Not necessarily. In Pres Guy’s words, “You do not need perfect credit and a 20% down payment to start your homeownership journey.” Programs such as FHA and VA loans, and conventional loans with mortgage insurance, can require less. A lender can tell you what you qualify for.

### What should I bring to a lender?

Lenders typically ask for recent pay stubs, W-2s or tax returns, bank statements, photo ID and information about your debts. Self-employed buyers usually need more history. Ask the loan officer for their exact list.

### What loan types does Pres Guy work with?

Conventional, FHA, VA and other loan programs. He focuses on structuring the loan around both your short-term and long-term goals.

Sources checked November 2026: CFPB: Prequalification vs. preapproval letters (<https://www.consumerfinance.gov/ask-cfpb/whats-the-difference-between-a-prequalification-letter-and-a-preapproval-letter-en-127/>) · CFPB: Loan Estimate explainer (<https://www.consumerfinance.gov/owning-a-home/loan-estimate/>) · CFPB: What is private mortgage insurance? (<https://www.consumerfinance.gov/ask-cfpb/what-is-private-mortgage-insurance-en-122/>) · NMLS Consumer Access (<https://www.nmlsconsumeraccess.org/>) . Rules, rates and forms change, so confirm the current version with each source or with your attorney, lender or tax adviser.

Straight answers

## Questions about reviews and standards

### Are these reviews edited?

No words are changed. Each card quotes a continuous passage from a review the client posted on Google, and longer reviews are shortened to an excerpt rather than rewritten. You can read the full reviews on Google.

### How can I check that Ally is licensed?

Use the North Carolina Real Estate Commission’s licensee search for Ally Bohanan (NC license #315170). Her brokerage is Northstar Real Estate, LLC. For South Carolina, the SC Department of Labor, Licensing and Regulation has its own license lookup for real estate licensees.

### Will I see what I am paying before I sign?

Yes. NCREC requires a written listing agreement before a firm markets a home, and that agreement must state the fee or how it is calculated. NCREC also states that compensation is negotiable. Ally explains the agreement line by line before you sign.

### What if something goes wrong?

Call Ally first at (704) 486-2900; most problems are solved by a direct conversation. If you believe a North Carolina broker has acted improperly, the NC Real Estate Commission accepts complaints online. In South Carolina, the SC Real Estate Commission handles complaints through SC LLR.

### Do you follow fair housing law?

Yes. Ally and her team follow the federal Fair Housing Act and state fair housing law, which prohibit discrimination in housing because of race, color, national origin, religion, sex (including sexual orientation and gender identity), familial status or disability. Questions about fair housing rights can go to HUD’s Office of Fair Housing and Equal Opportunity.

A rough estimate of principal and interest, plus taxes and insurance if you know them. It is not a loan offer. Confirm real numbers with a lender.

The short answer

This calculator estimates a monthly mortgage payment for a home in Gastonia or nearby: principal and interest from your price, down payment, rate and term, plus property tax and insurance if you enter them. It is not a loan offer, and it leaves out mortgage insurance, HOA dues and closing costs. Confirm real numbers with a lender.
Updated November 2026

## Next steps

Talk with Ally’s preferred lender (<https://allybohananrealestate.com/ally-bohanan-real-estate-preview/our-preferred-lender/>) for a pre-approval, or talk with a buyer’s agent (<https://allybohananrealestate.com/ally-bohanan-real-estate-preview/buyer-agent-services-in-gastonia-nc/#buyer-form>) .

How it works

## How is a mortgage payment calculated?

Most home loans are amortized. Each monthly payment is the same, but early payments go mostly to interest and later payments go mostly to principal. The calculator uses the standard amortization formula with the price minus your down payment as the loan amount.

Your full monthly housing cost is often called PITI: principal, interest, taxes and insurance. Add mortgage insurance and HOA dues where they apply. The Loan Estimate (<https://www.consumerfinance.gov/owning-a-home/loan-estimate/>) a lender gives you lists each of these.

The fine print

## What does this calculator leave out?

- Mortgage insurance. Usually required on conventional loans with less than 20 percent down, and on FHA loans.
- HOA dues. Common in planned communities around Belmont, Fort Mill and Lake Wylie.
- Flood insurance. Required by lenders in mapped flood zones near the Catawba River and its creeks.
- Closing costs. Lender fees, attorney fees, title insurance and prepaid items, paid at closing.
- Due diligence fee and earnest money. In North Carolina, both are paid before closing and credited to you if the sale closes.

Local taxes

## What are property taxes like around Gastonia?

In North Carolina, the county and the city each set a rate per $100 of assessed value. Gaston County’s rate is 59.9 cents as of July 1, 2026. Homes inside a city such as Gastonia, Belmont or Mount Holly also pay that city’s rate, and homes outside city limits may pay a small fire district tax.

In South Carolina, an owner-occupied primary residence is assessed at 4 percent of value instead of 6 percent, once you apply with the county. That is one reason York County payments can look different at the same price.

Straight answers

## Mortgage calculator questions

### What does this mortgage calculator include?

Principal and interest, based on the price, down payment, rate and term you enter, plus property taxes and homeowners insurance if you add them. It does not include mortgage insurance, HOA dues, flood insurance or closing costs.

### What is PMI, and when do I pay it?

Private mortgage insurance protects the lender, not you. On a conventional loan it is usually required when you put down less than 20 percent. FHA loans have their own mortgage insurance premiums. Your lender will show the cost on your Loan Estimate.

### Should I choose a 15-, 20- or 30-year term?

A shorter term usually means a higher monthly payment but far less interest over the life of the loan. A 30-year term keeps the payment lower and leaves room in your budget. Try each term above to see the difference, then talk it through with a lender.

### How do I estimate property taxes in Gaston County?

Multiply the assessed value by the rate per $100. Gaston County’s rate is 59.9 cents per $100 as of July 1, 2026, so a home assessed at $400,000 would owe about $2,396 a year in county tax, before any city or fire district tax. Check the county’s tax rate chart (<https://www.gastongov.com/DocumentCenter/View/1486/Tax-Rates-PDF>) for the city rates.

### Do HOA dues affect how much I can borrow?

Yes. Lenders count HOA dues in your monthly obligations, so a home with higher dues can lower the price you qualify for. Ask for the dues and any special assessments early.

Sources checked November 2026: Gaston County tax rates (<https://www.gastongov.com/DocumentCenter/View/1486/Tax-Rates-PDF>) · Gaston County FY27 tax bill insert (<https://www.gastongov.com/DocumentCenter/View/9583/Corrected-FY27-Budget-Tax-Bill-Insert-PDF>) · SC Department of Revenue: property tax exemptions (<https://www.dor.sc.gov/property/property-tax-exemptions>) · CFPB: Loan Estimate (<https://www.consumerfinance.gov/owning-a-home/loan-estimate/>) · CFPB: Private mortgage insurance (<https://www.consumerfinance.gov/ask-cfpb/what-is-private-mortgage-insurance-en-122/>) . Rules, rates and forms change, so confirm the current version with each source or with your attorney, lender or tax adviser.

Straight answers

## Questions people ask

### How are events on this site checked?

Every event is added only after we confirm its date, start time and venue on the organizer’s own page or the town or county calendar. Each listing links to that page. Past events drop off on their own, and game times come from the team or league schedule.

### Which towns does Lifestyle cover?

Gaston County, North Carolina, including Belmont, Mount Holly, Gastonia, Kings Mountain, McAdenville, Lowell, Dallas and Cherryville. It also covers York County, South Carolina, including Fort Mill, Rock Hill, York, Clover and Lake Wylie, plus Uptown Charlotte for game days.

### Is Plan My Weekend free?

Yes. There is no sign-up. Pick a starting town, a date, how much time you have and what sounds good, and it builds a two- or three-stop plan from verified places and events. You can share or print the plan.

### Where are the official visitor calendars?

Gaston County Travel & Tourism keeps the Go Gaston events calendar (<https://www.gogastonnc.org/events>) , and the Rock Hill and Fort Mill visitors bureau keeps the Visit York County events (<https://www.visityorkcounty.com/events/>) calendar. Towns post their own events too.

### Can Ally help me find a home near these places?

Yes. Ally lives and works in Belmont and helps buyers across Gaston and York counties. Start with her buyer-agent services (<https://allybohananrealestate.com/ally-bohanan-real-estate-preview/buyer-agent-services-in-gastonia-nc/>) , or the relocation page (<https://allybohananrealestate.com/ally-bohanan-real-estate-preview/relocation/>) if you are moving from out of the area.

## How this calendar is kept

We add an event only after confirming its date, time and venue on the organizer’s own page or on a town or county calendar. Each card links that source. Sports dates come from the team or league schedule. Events drop off by your device’s date, so you only see what is still ahead. If a listing and its official page disagree, trust the official page and let us know through the contact page (<https://allybohananrealestate.com/ally-bohanan-real-estate-preview/contact/>) .

Thinking about living near these traditions? The Lifestyle magazine (<https://allybohananrealestate.com/ally-bohanan-real-estate-preview/lifestyle/>) has weekend guides by town. Ally’s relocation help (<https://allybohananrealestate.com/ally-bohanan-real-estate-preview/relocation/>) starts with which town fits your weekends.

Straight answers

## Questions people ask

### Where are the official event calendars for Gaston and York counties?

Gaston County Travel & Tourism runs the Go Gaston events calendar (<https://www.gogastonnc.org/events>) . In South Carolina, the Rock Hill and Fort Mill visitors bureau runs the Visit York County events (<https://www.visityorkcounty.com/events/>) calendar. Town calendars, such as Gaston County government (<https://www.gastongov.com/calendar.aspx?view=list>) , the Town of Fort Mill (<https://www.fortmillsc.gov/calendar.aspx>) , the City of Gastonia (<https://gastonianc.gov/residents/city-events>) and Downtown Belmont (<https://downtownbelmont.org/>) , post parades and tree lightings first.

### How do I add an event to my phone’s calendar?

Use the Add to calendar button on any event. It downloads a standard calendar file that works with Apple Calendar, Google Calendar and Outlook, with the venue and the official link included.

### Are these events free?

Some are. When an organizer says an event is free, the card says so. Otherwise, the official link has the current ticket prices, which change from year to year.

### Can I suggest an event?

Yes. Send the official event page through the contact page (<https://allybohananrealestate.com/ally-bohanan-real-estate-preview/contact/>) . We add events that have a published date, time and venue from the organizer.

Facts in these answers checked November 19, 2026 against: Go Gaston events calendar (<https://www.gogastonnc.org/events>) · Visit York County events (<https://www.visityorkcounty.com/events/>) . Hours, fees and dates change, so confirm with each source before you go.

The short answer

Plan My Weekend is a free planner for Gaston County, York County and Charlotte. Choose a starting town, a date, how much time you have and an interest. It builds a two- or three-stop plan from verified places and events, timed around published hours and start times, with directions and official links.

## How to use Plan My Weekend

Start with the town you will leave from. The planner knows 10 starting towns on both sides of the state line: Belmont, Mount Holly, Gastonia, Kings Mountain, Lake Wylie, Charlotte, Clover, Fort Mill, York and Rock Hill. Pick a date and how much time you have: a morning or afternoon of about four hours, the whole day, or an evening from 5 p.m. Then pick what sounds good. If an event with a verified start time falls on your date, the plan is built around it. Otherwise it uses places that are open at the time you need them, starting in your town and moving to neighboring towns.

Every stop links to its official site, directions and the town guide, and you can share or print the plan. Hours and dates change, so check each official link before you leave. Where they play

## Four venues, close to home

The big-league teams play in Uptown Charlotte, and pro baseball is in downtown Gastonia.

### Bank of America Stadium

800 S. Mint St., Charlotte. This is home to the Carolina Panthers and Charlotte FC. The stadium says there are more than 30,000 parking spaces within a 10 to 15 minute walk, and Brooklyn Village Station on the LYNX Blue Line is just over a football field from the gates (Bank of America Stadium (<https://www.bankofamericastadium.com/stadium/parking.html>) ). Check the Carolina Panthers schedule (<https://www.panthers.com/schedule/2026/>) and Charlotte FC schedule (<https://www.charlottefootballclub.com/schedule/2027>) for home dates.

### Spectrum Center

333 E. Trade St., Charlotte. This is home to the Charlotte Hornets. It also hosts concerts and college basketball, including the Dick Vitale Invitational (Spectrum Center (<https://www.spectrumcentercharlotte.com/>) ). Most Hornets home games start in the evening, so it is an easy weeknight trip from Belmont or Mount Holly.

### Truist Field

324 S. Mint St., Charlotte. This is home to the Charlotte Knights, the Triple-A affiliate of the Chicago White Sox. Truist Field has no parking lot of its own, and the Knights partner with the Mint Street Parking Garage across from the gates. In winter the ballpark hosts Light the Knights (Charlotte Knights (<https://www.milb.com/charlotte-knights/ballpark>) ).

### CaroMont Health Park

800 W. Franklin Blvd., Gastonia. This is home to the Gastonia Ghost Peppers of the Atlantic League of Professional Baseball, with more than 5,000 stadium seats (Go Gaston (<https://www.gogastonnc.org/places/caromont-health-park>) ). It is in downtown Gastonia, so you can pair a game with dinner on Main Avenue without driving into Charlotte.

## Getting there from Gaston County

From Belmont, Mount Holly or Gastonia, most fans drive into Uptown on I-85 or on Wilkinson Boulevard (US-74). Bank of America Stadium tells drivers on I-85 to exit at Billy Graham Parkway, Freedom Drive, the Brookshire Freeway (I-277 East) or I-77 South. Drivers on Wilkinson Boulevard should follow signs for the John Belk Freeway (I-277) (Bank of America Stadium (<https://www.bankofamericastadium.com/stadium/parking.html>) ). If you would rather not drive Uptown, park at any LYNX Blue Line Park & Ride and ride to Brooklyn Village Station. The round trip is $4.40 in the CATS-Pass app, with parking included. CATS Route 85x links Gastonia and Belmont to Uptown, but it runs weekday commuter trips only (City of Belmont (<https://www.cityofbelmont.org/bus/>) ).

Game days are one reason people choose a home just west of the Catawba River. Read the Belmont (<https://allybohananrealestate.com/ally-bohanan-real-estate-preview/belmont/>) and Gastonia (<https://allybohananrealestate.com/ally-bohanan-real-estate-preview/gastonia/>) guides, or see how Ally helps on the relocation page (<https://allybohananrealestate.com/ally-bohanan-real-estate-preview/relocation/>) .

Straight answers

## Questions people ask

### Where do the Panthers, Hornets and Knights play?

The Panthers and Charlotte FC play at Bank of America Stadium, 800 S. Mint St. The Hornets play at Spectrum Center, 333 E. Trade St., and the Knights at Truist Field, 324 S. Mint St. All three venues are in Uptown Charlotte.

### Can I take the light rail to a Panthers game?

Yes. Park at any LYNX Blue Line Park & Ride and ride to Brooklyn Village Station. A round trip is $4.40 in the CATS-Pass app, with parking included (Bank of America Stadium (<https://www.bankofamericastadium.com/stadium/parking.html>) ).

### Is there a bus from Gaston County to Uptown on game day?

CATS Route 85x, the Gastonia Express, stops at a park-and-ride at Abbey Plaza in Belmont, but it runs weekday commuter trips only (City of Belmont (<https://www.cityofbelmont.org/bus/>) ), so it rarely fits a game.

### Where can I see a pro game without going to Charlotte?

At CaroMont Health Park, 800 W. Franklin Blvd., in downtown Gastonia, home of the Gastonia Ghost Peppers in the Atlantic League of Professional Baseball (Go Gaston (<https://www.gogastonnc.org/places/caromont-health-park>) ). Check the team schedule for home dates.

Facts in these answers checked November 19, 2026 against: Bank of America Stadium: traffic and parking (<https://www.bankofamericastadium.com/stadium/parking.html>) · Spectrum Center (<https://www.spectrumcentercharlotte.com/>) · Charlotte Knights: Truist Field (<https://www.milb.com/charlotte-knights/ballpark>) · Go Gaston: CaroMont Health Park (<https://www.gogastonnc.org/places/caromont-health-park>) · City of Belmont: bus routes (<https://www.cityofbelmont.org/bus/>) · CATS: Route 85x Gastonia Express (<https://www.charlottenc.gov/CATS/Ride/Bus/85x>) . Hours, fees and dates change, so confirm with each source before you go.

Straight answers

## Questions people ask

### Which Main Streets have the best coffee and bookshops?

Mount Holly is the strongest, with Cleary’s Bookstore and Black Sheep Coffee at 104 S. Main St. and Owl Legs Coffee nearby. Belmont, Gastonia, Kings Mountain, Clover and York each have at least one good coffee or bookshop stop. The Main Street coffee guide (<https://allybohananrealestate.com/ally-bohanan-real-estate-preview/lifestyle/main-street-coffee-and-bookshops/>) lists them by town.

### When is Cleary’s Bookstore open?

Tuesday to Thursday 9 a.m. to 7 p.m., Friday and Saturday 8 a.m. to 6 p.m., and Sunday 9 a.m. to 4 p.m. It is closed on Mondays (Cleary’s Bookstore (<https://www.clearysbookstore.com/>) ).

### Where can I get dinner in downtown Gastonia?

Lotus Chophouse is at 245 W. Garrison Blvd. If you are pairing dinner with a game, CaroMont Health Park, home of the Gastonia Ghost Peppers, is in downtown Gastonia at 800 W. Franklin Blvd.

### How do you choose these places?

Each place comes from its own official site or a current county or town tourism listing. We link that source and use the hours it publishes. Plan My Weekend only suggests a place during its published hours.

Facts in these answers checked November 19, 2026 against: Cleary’s Bookstore (<https://www.clearysbookstore.com/>) · Go Gaston: CaroMont Health Park (<https://www.gogastonnc.org/places/caromont-health-park>) . Hours, fees and dates change, so confirm with each source before you go.

Straight answers

## Questions people ask

### Where can I get on Lake Wylie without a lake house?

In Gaston County, try South Point Access in Belmont, 175 Boat Launch Road. It charges $7 per vehicle (Gaston County (<https://www.gastongov.com/Facilities/Facility/Details/South-Point-Access-51>) ). You can also try Tailrace Marina or the River Street Park kayak launch in Mount Holly. The Lake Wylie access guide (<https://allybohananrealestate.com/ally-bohanan-real-estate-preview/lifestyle/lake-wylie-public-access/>) has details.

### What are Crowders Mountain State Park’s hours?

Gates open at 8 a.m. They close at 6 p.m. from November through February, 8 p.m. in March, April and October, and 9 p.m. from May through September. The park is closed on Christmas Day (NC State Parks (<https://www.ncparks.gov/state-parks/crowders-mountain-state-park>) ).

### Are dogs allowed on the trails?

At the Anne Springs Close Greenway, leashed dogs are welcome at no extra cost (ASC Greenway (<https://www.ascgreenway.org/visit/hours-fees/>) ). At South Point Access, dogs must be on a leash six feet or shorter and stay out of the beach area (Gaston County (<https://www.gastongov.com/Facilities/Facility/Details/South-Point-Access-51>) ).

### How big is Lake Wylie?

SC DNR lists about 13,443 acres and 325 miles of shoreline. The lake sits on the North Carolina and South Carolina border between Rock Hill and Charlotte, and it is owned and managed by Duke Energy (SC DNR (<https://dnr.sc.gov/lakes/wylie/description.html>) ).

Facts in these answers checked November 19, 2026 against: Gaston County: South Point Access (<https://www.gastongov.com/Facilities/Facility/Details/South-Point-Access-51>) · NC State Parks: Crowders Mountain (<https://www.ncparks.gov/state-parks/crowders-mountain-state-park>) · Anne Springs Close Greenway: hours and fees (<https://www.ascgreenway.org/visit/hours-fees/>) · SC DNR: Lake Wylie (<https://dnr.sc.gov/lakes/wylie/description.html>) . Hours, fees and dates change, so confirm with each source before you go.

Straight answers

## Questions people ask

### What is a good free cultural stop near Rock Hill?

Glencairn Garden, 725 Crest Street, has no admission fee and is open daily from dawn to dusk (City of Rock Hill (<https://www.cityofrockhill.com/Home/Components/FacilityDirectory/FacilityDirectory/86/151>) ). The Old Town Mural Mile is outdoors and spread across downtown (Visit Rock Hill (<https://www.visitrockhillsc.com/mural-mile/>) ).

### When is the Schiele Museum open?

Monday to Friday 10 a.m. to 4 p.m., Saturday 10 a.m. to 5 p.m. and Sunday 1 to 5 p.m. It closes on Easter, Thanksgiving, Christmas Eve and Christmas Day (Schiele Museum (<https://www.schielemuseum.org/>) ).

### How much is Historic Brattonsville?

$12 for adults, $10 for seniors 60 and up and $8 for youth 4 to 17. Members and children 3 and younger are free. It is open Tuesday to Saturday 10 a.m. to 5 p.m. and Sunday 1 to 5 p.m., closed Mondays, and pets are not permitted (Culture & Heritage Museums (<https://chmuseums.org/plan-your-visit-hb/>) ).

### How much is Daniel Stowe Conservancy?

The Gardens at Stowe cost $18.95 plus tax for adults, $16.95 for seniors and $10.95 for children 2 to 12, and tickets are sold in person. The trails and dog park are free (Daniel Stowe Conservancy (<https://danielstoweconservancy.org/visit/hoursandadmission/>) ).

### Is there a ready-made weekend plan?

Yes. A Saturday in Belmont (<https://allybohananrealestate.com/ally-bohanan-real-estate-preview/lifestyle/a-saturday-in-belmont/>) and A Weekend Exploring Gaston County (<https://allybohananrealestate.com/ally-bohanan-real-estate-preview/lifestyle/a-weekend-exploring-gaston-county/>) are full itineraries. Plan My Weekend (<https://allybohananrealestate.com/ally-bohanan-real-estate-preview/lifestyle/plan-my-weekend/>) builds one from any starting town.

# A Saturday in Belmont

Coffee and the History Walk downtown, an afternoon on the Catawba, and an evening in the garden.

By Ally Bohanan (<https://allybohananrealestate.com/ally-bohanan-real-estate-preview/about-ally-bohanan/>)
Reviewed November 19, 2026

Stops

4

Towns

Belmont, Lake Wylie

When

One day · Morning to evening

Read

1 min

The short answer

Spend the morning on foot in downtown Belmont: coffee, Belmont Bookshop, the History Walk and Stowe Park. Spend the afternoon on the water at Kevin Loftin Riverfront Park or South Point Access on Lake Wylie, then end the day at Daniel Stowe Conservancy south of town.
Updated November 19, 2026

Belmont rewards a slow Saturday. Everything in this plan is within a short drive of Ally’s office on North Main Street, and the morning half needs no car at all.

Arts, Culture & Weekend Guides

The plan

Stop 01Belmont

## Morning: Main Street on foot

Park once and walk. Belmont’s downtown spans three historic districts, and the town’s self-guided History Walk introduces the people and buildings behind them. Locally owned shops, coffee houses and Belmont Bookshop are all within a few blocks, according to Go Gaston (<https://www.gogastonnc.org/belmont>) .

Go Gaston (<https://www.gogastonnc.org/belmont>)

Stop 02Belmont

## Late morning: Stowe Park

The green at the center of downtown hosts farmers markets, concerts and Movies in the Park in warmer months. In December it fills with decorated trees for the Festival of Trees (<https://downtownbelmont.org/festival-of-trees/>) .

Festival of Trees (<https://downtownbelmont.org/festival-of-trees/>)

Stop 03Belmont

## Afternoon: the river

Choose your pace. Kevin Loftin Riverfront Park sits on the Catawba River. South Point Access has a sandy Lake Wylie shoreline. Rocky Branch Park is the town’s mountain-bike trail system.

Stop 04Belmont

## Evening: Daniel Stowe Conservancy

End the day in the gardens south of town. From late November through December 30, Holidays at the Garden (<https://danielstoweconservancy.org/visit/holidays/>) lights the grounds on select nights from 5 to 10 p.m. Buy tickets ahead.

Holidays at the Garden (<https://danielstoweconservancy.org/visit/holidays/>)

Checked against: Go Gaston: Belmont (<https://www.gogastonnc.org/belmont>) · Downtown Belmont (<https://downtownbelmont.org/>) · Daniel Stowe Conservancy (<https://danielstoweconservancy.org/visit/holidays/>) . Details change, so confirm hours, dates and prices with each source before you go.

## If you live here

For people who live in Belmont, this is a normal Saturday. Downtown is walkable, the Catawba River is at the edge of town, and Lake Wylie’s public shoreline is a short drive south. Belmont sits just over the river from Charlotte, off I-85 on the Gaston County side, according to Go Gaston (<https://www.gogastonnc.org/belmont>) . Read the Belmont community guide (<https://allybohananrealestate.com/ally-bohanan-real-estate-preview/belmont/>) or compare Belmont with Mount Holly (<https://allybohananrealestate.com/ally-bohanan-real-estate-preview/communities/compare/belmont-vs-mount-holly/>) . When you are ready to look at homes, Ally’s buyer-agent services (<https://allybohananrealestate.com/ally-bohanan-real-estate-preview/buyer-agent-services-in-gastonia-nc/>) explain how she works. If you already own here, start with a home value check (<https://allybohananrealestate.com/ally-bohanan-real-estate-preview/home-value-in-gastonia-nc/>) .

BelmontCommunity guide (<https://allybohananrealestate.com/ally-bohanan-real-estate-preview/belmont/>)

Lake WylieCommunity guide (<https://allybohananrealestate.com/ally-bohanan-real-estate-preview/lake-wylie/>)

Straight answers

## Before you go

### Is there a fee at South Point Access?

Yes. Gaston County lists South Point Access, 175 Boat Launch Road, at $7 per vehicle and $20 per bus. Winter hours, November 1 through March 31, are 6 a.m. to 7 p.m. The swim beach opens only from Memorial Day through Labor Day (Gaston County (<https://www.gastongov.com/Facilities/Facility/Details/South-Point-Access-51>) ).

### How much does Daniel Stowe Conservancy cost?

Daytime admission to The Gardens at Stowe is $18.95 plus tax for adults, $16.95 for seniors 60 and up and $10.95 for children 2 to 12. Children under 2 and members get in free, and day passes are sold in person. The trails, dog park, Trailhead Store and Farmhouse Garden Center are free (Daniel Stowe Conservancy (<https://danielstoweconservancy.org/visit/hoursandadmission/>) ). Holidays at the Garden is a separate ticket. Entry runs from 5 to 9 p.m., and parking is free (Holidays at the Garden (<https://danielstoweconservancy.org/visit/holidays/>) ).

### Can I bring my dog?

At South Point Access, dogs must stay on a leash six feet or shorter and are not allowed in the beach area (Gaston County (<https://www.gastongov.com/Facilities/Facility/Details/South-Point-Access-51>) ). Daniel Stowe Conservancy has a free dog park and free scenic trails. Check its site for the rules inside The Gardens (Daniel Stowe Conservancy (<https://danielstoweconservancy.org/visit/hoursandadmission/>) ).

### Do I need a car for this day?

Not for the morning. Downtown Belmont is compact enough to park once and walk to coffee, the bookshop, the History Walk and Stowe Park. You will want a car for the afternoon and evening, because the riverfront, South Point and the gardens are outside downtown.

Facts in these answers checked November 19, 2026 against: Gaston County: South Point Access (<https://www.gastongov.com/Facilities/Facility/Details/South-Point-Access-51>) · Daniel Stowe Conservancy: hours and admission (<https://danielstoweconservancy.org/visit/hoursandadmission/>) · Daniel Stowe Conservancy: Holidays at the Garden (<https://danielstoweconservancy.org/visit/holidays/>) . Hours, fees and dates change, so confirm with each source before you go.

# A Weekend Exploring Gaston County

A summit hike, a planetarium, a nutcracker museum and two Main Streets, in one easy weekend.

By Ally Bohanan (<https://allybohananrealestate.com/ally-bohanan-real-estate-preview/about-ally-bohanan/>)
Reviewed November 19, 2026

Stops

5

Towns

Gastonia, Kings Mountain, Mount Holly

When

Weekend · Saturday–Sunday

Read

2 min

The short answer

On Saturday, hike Crowders Mountain in the morning, spend the afternoon at the Schiele Museum and its planetarium in Gastonia, and have dinner downtown. On Sunday, have coffee and see Nutty for Nutcrackers in Kings Mountain, then finish on Main Street and the RiverHawk Greenway in Mount Holly.
Updated November 19, 2026

Gaston County is easy to underestimate from I-85. Give it a weekend and it becomes a place with mountains, a planetarium and the largest downtown in the county.

Day 1

Saturday

Stop 01Gaston County

## Saturday morning: Crowders Mountain

The Crowders Mountain Trail at 522 Park Office Lane is 2.5 miles one way over natural surface, boardwalk and gravel. The Backside Trail is a steeper half-mile for the final climb (Go Gaston (<https://www.gogastonnc.org/gastonia>) ).

Stop522 Park Office Lane
Go Gaston (<https://www.gogastonnc.org/gastonia>)

Stop 02Gastonia

## Saturday afternoon: the Schiele Museum

At 1500 E. Garrison Blvd. in Gastonia, the Schiele Museum has the James H. Lynn Planetarium, a new Dinosaur Hall and a 0.7-mile nature trail. Saturday hours are 10 a.m. to 5 p.m.

Stop1500 E. Garrison Blvd.

Stop 03Gastonia

## Saturday evening: downtown Gastonia

Gaston County’s largest downtown has shops, restaurants and public art. Lotus Chophouse is at 245 W. Garrison Blvd.

Stop245 W. Garrison Blvd.

Day 2

Sunday

Stop 04Kings Mountain

## Sunday morning: Kings Mountain

Coffee at The Social House by Royal T on South Railroad Avenue. Then Nutty for Nutcrackers at 210 S. Piedmont Ave., more than 3,400 pieces, billed as the largest nutcracker collection east of the Mississippi (Go Gaston (<https://www.gogastonnc.org/kings-mountain>) ). Check the museum’s hours before you go.

Stop210 S. Piedmont Ave.
Go Gaston (<https://www.gogastonnc.org/kings-mountain>)

Stop 05Mount Holly

## Sunday afternoon: Mount Holly by the river

Finish on Main Street in Mount Holly with Cleary’s Bookstore and Black Sheep Coffee at 104 S. Main St., then walk the RiverHawk Greenway from Tuckaseegee Park (Go Gaston (<https://www.gogastonnc.org/mount-holly>) ).

Want to see whether one of these towns could be home? Start with Find My Carolina Community (<https://allybohananrealestate.com/ally-bohanan-real-estate-preview/communities/find-my-fit/>) .

Stop104 S. Main St.
Go Gaston (<https://www.gogastonnc.org/mount-holly>)

Checked against: Go Gaston: Gastonia (<https://www.gogastonnc.org/gastonia>) · Go Gaston: Kings Mountain (<https://www.gogastonnc.org/kings-mountain>) · Go Gaston: Mount Holly (<https://www.gogastonnc.org/mount-holly>) . Details change, so confirm hours, dates and prices with each source before you go.

## If you live here

This weekend covers three different Gaston County towns. Gastonia is the county’s largest downtown, on I-85 and US-321. Kings Mountain sits at the western edge of the county near the state line. Mount Holly is on the Catawba River just across from Charlotte. Read the Gastonia (<https://allybohananrealestate.com/ally-bohanan-real-estate-preview/gastonia/>) , Kings Mountain (<https://allybohananrealestate.com/ally-bohanan-real-estate-preview/kings-mountain/>) and Mount Holly (<https://allybohananrealestate.com/ally-bohanan-real-estate-preview/mount-holly/>) guides. If you are moving from out of the area, the relocation page (<https://allybohananrealestate.com/ally-bohanan-real-estate-preview/relocation/>) explains how Ally helps people choose a town before they choose a house.

Kings MountainCommunity guide (<https://allybohananrealestate.com/ally-bohanan-real-estate-preview/kings-mountain/>)

Straight answers

## Before you go

### What are Crowders Mountain State Park’s hours?

Gates open at 8 a.m. year-round. They close at 6 p.m. from November through February, at 8 p.m. in March, April and October, and at 9 p.m. from May through September. The visitor center is open daily from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m., and the park is closed on Christmas Day. Gates are locked at the posted time, so plan to be back at your car (NC State Parks (<https://www.ncparks.gov/state-parks/crowders-mountain-state-park>) ).

### Where do I park for the Crowders Mountain Trail?

Use the Sparrow Springs Access and Visitor Center at 522 Park Office Lane, Kings Mountain. The park also has the Linwood Road Access at 4611 Linwood Road, Gastonia, and the Boulders Access at 108 Vandyke Road, Kings Mountain (NC State Parks (<https://www.ncparks.gov/state-parks/crowders-mountain-state-park>) ).

### When is the Schiele Museum open?

Monday to Friday 10 a.m. to 4 p.m., Saturday 10 a.m. to 5 p.m. and Sunday 1 to 5 p.m. It closes on Easter, Thanksgiving, Christmas Eve and Christmas Day (Schiele Museum (<https://www.schielemuseum.org/>) ). Check the museum’s site for admission and planetarium show times.

### When is Nutty for Nutcrackers open?

Thursday and Friday 11 a.m. to 6 p.m., and Saturday 9 a.m. to 4 p.m., at 210 S. Piedmont Ave. in Kings Mountain (Nutty for Nutcrackers (<https://www.nuttyfornutcrackers.com/>) ). It is closed on the Sunday of this plan, so swap it to Saturday if the nutcrackers are a must.

Facts in these answers checked November 19, 2026 against: NC State Parks: Crowders Mountain (<https://www.ncparks.gov/state-parks/crowders-mountain-state-park>) · Schiele Museum (<https://www.schielemuseum.org/>) · Nutty for Nutcrackers (<https://www.nuttyfornutcrackers.com/>) . Hours, fees and dates change, so confirm with each source before you go.
